title: द्विचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Karna attacks Sahadeva and taunts him as he strikes him, saying that Arjuna alone is a match for him. Shalya and Sahadeva fight, and the Pandava army, struck by Arjuna, scatters.
summary.kn: ಕರ್ಣ ಸಹದೇವನ ಮೇಲೆ ಎರಗಿ ಹೊಡೆಯುತ್ತಾ ಅರ್ಜುನನೇ ತನಗೆ ಸಮಾನನೆಂದು ಗೇಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಶಲ್ಯ-ಸಹದೇವರು ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅರ್ಜುನನಿಂದ ಹೊಡೆಯಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಚದುರುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: कर्ण सहदेव पर आक्रमण कर प्रहार करते हुए ताना मारता है कि अर्जुन ही उसके बराबर है। शल्य और सहदेव लड़ते हैं, और अर्जुन से पिटी सेना बिखर जाती है।
summary.te: కర్ణుడు సహదేవునిపై దాడి చేసి కొడుతూ అర్జునుడే తనకు సమానుడని ఎగతాళి చేస్తాడు. శల్య సహదేవులు పోరాడతారు; అర్జునునిచే కొట్టబడిన సేన చెదిరిపోతుంది.
summary.ta: கர்ணன் சகதேவனைத் தாக்கிக் கேலி செய்து, அர்ஜுனனே தனக்கு நிகர் என்கிறான். சல்யனும் சகதேவனும் போரிட, அர்ஜுனனால் அடிக்கப்பட்ட படை சிதறுகிறது.
summary.ml: കർണ്ണൻ സഹദേവനെ ആക്രമിക്കുന്നു; അടിക്കുന്നതിനിടയിൽ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ പരിഹസിക്കുന്നു, അർജുനൻ മാത്രമാണ് തനിക്ക് തുല്യനെന്ന് പറയുന്നു. ശല്യരും സഹദേവനും പൊരുതുന്നു; അർജുനൻ പ്രഹരിച്ച പാണ്ഡവ സേന ചിതറിപ്പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.142; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
सहदेवमथायान्तं द्रोणप्रेप्सुं विशां पते ।
कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे वारयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: As Sahadeva came on, wanting to reach Drona, Karna, son of Vikartana, held him back in the battle, O lord of the people.

verses.text:
सहदेवस्तु राधेयं विद्ध्वा नवभिराशुगैः ।
पुनर्विव्याध दशभिर्निशितैर्नतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: Sahadeva pierced Radha's son with nine swift arrows, and again with ten sharp, bent-jointed ones.

verses.text:
तं कर्णः प्रतिविव्याध शतेन नतपर्वणाम् ।
सज्यं चास्य धनुः शीघ्रं चिच्छेद लघुहस्तवत् ॥

meaning.en: Karna pierced him back with a hundred bent-jointed arrows, and quickly cut his strung bow with a light hand.

verses.text:
ततोऽन्यद्धनुरादाय माद्रीपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।
कर्णं विव्याध विंशत्या तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the glorious son of Madri took another bow and pierced Karna with twenty arrows; it was like a marvel.

verses.text:
तस्य कर्णो हयान्हत्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ।
सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन द्रुतं निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: Karna killed his horses with bent-jointed arrows and with a broad-headed arrow quickly sent his charioteer to Yama's house.

verses.text:
विरथः सहदेवस्तु खड्गं चर्म समाददे ।
तदप्यस्य शरैः कर्णो व्यधमत्प्रहसन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Sahadeva, chariotless, took up sword and shield; but Karna, almost smiling, shattered those too with arrows.

verses.text:
ततो गुर्वीं महाघोरां हेमचित्रां महागदाम् ।
प्रेषयामास समरे वैकर्तनरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then he hurled a heavy, most dreadful, gold-bright great mace at the chariot of Vikartana's son in the battle.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं सहसा सहदेवप्रवेरिताम् ।
व्यष्टम्भयच्छरैः कर्णो भूमौ चैनामपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: As that mace, sent by Sahadeva, came suddenly, Karna stopped it with arrows and made it fall to the ground.

verses.text:
गदां विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा सहदेवस्त्वरान्वितः ।
शक्तिं चिक्षेप कर्णाय तामप्यस्याच्छिनच्छरैः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his mace destroyed, Sahadeva in haste hurled a spear at Karna; he cut that down too with arrows.

verses.text:
ससंभ्रमस्ततस्तूर्णमवप्लुत्य रथोत्तमात् ।
सहदेवो महाराज दृष्ट्वा कर्णं व्यवस्थितम् ।
रथचक्रं ततो गृह्य मुमोचाधिरथिं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then in a rush, O great king, Sahadeva leapt from his best of chariots, and seeing Karna standing there, picked up a chariot wheel and hurled it at Adhiratha's son.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं सहसा कालचक्रमिवोद्यतम् ।
शरैरनेकसाहस्रैरच्छिनत्सूतनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: As it came suddenly like a raised wheel of time, the charioteer's son (Karna) cut it with many thousands of arrows.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तु वितथे चक्रे कृते तेन महात्मना ।
वार्यमाणश्च विशिखैः सहदेवो रणं जहौ ॥

meaning.en: When that great-souled man had made the wheel useless, and while being held back with arrows, Sahadeva left the battle.

verses.text:
तमभिद्रुत्य राधेयो मुहूर्ताद्भरतर्षभ ।
अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्वाक्यं सहदेवं विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Then Radha's son pursued him, and after a moment, best of Bharatas, spoke smiling to Sahadeva, O lord of the people.

verses.text:
मा युध्यस्व रणे वीर विशिष्टै रथिभिः सह ।
सदृशैर्युध्य माद्रेय वचो मे मा विशङ्किथाः ॥

meaning.en: "Do not fight in battle, hero, with chariot-warriors better than you. Fight your equals, son of Madri; do not doubt my word."

verses.text:
अथैनं धनुषोऽग्रेण तुदन्भूयोऽब्रवीद्वचः ।
एषोऽर्जुनो रणे यत्तो युध्यते कुरुभिः सह ।
तत्र गच्छस्व माद्रेय गृहं वा यदि मन्यसे ॥

meaning.en: Then, goading him with the tip of his bow, he spoke again: "There is Arjuna, fighting with the Kurus in the battle. Go there, son of Madri, or go home if you wish."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा तु तं कर्णो रथेन रथिनां वरः ।
प्रायात्पाञ्चालपाण्डूनां सैन्यानि प्रहसन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, Karna, best of charioteers, drove in his chariot through the armies of the Panchalas and Pandavas, almost laughing.

verses.text:
वधप्राप्तं तु माद्रेयं नावधीत्समरेऽरिहा ।
कुन्त्याः स्मृत्वा वचो राजन्सत्यसंधो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Though the Madri's son had come within reach of death, the foe-slayer, true to his word, did not kill him, remembering Kunti's request, O king.

verses.text:
सहदेवस्ततो राजन्विमनाः शरपीडितः ।
कर्णवाक्शल्यतप्तश्च जीवितान्निरविद्यत ॥

meaning.en: Then Sahadeva, O king, dispirited, hurt by arrows and burned by Karna's words, grew weary of life.

verses.text:
आरुरोह रथं चापि पाञ्चाल्यस्य महात्मनः ।
जनमेजयस्य समरे त्वरायुक्तो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: The great warrior then quickly mounted the chariot of the great-souled Janamejaya, the Panchala prince, in the battle.

verses.text:
विराटं सहसेनं तु द्रोणार्थे द्रुतमागतम् ।
मद्रराजः शरौघेण छादयामास धन्विनम् ॥

meaning.en: The king of Madra (Shalya) covered with a flood of arrows the archer Virata, who had come in haste with his army for Drona's sake.

verses.text:
तयोः समभवद्युद्धं समरे दृढधन्विनोः ।
यादृशं ह्यभवद्राजञ्जम्भवासवयोः पुरा ॥

meaning.en: A battle took place between the two firm archers, such as there once was, O king, between Jambha and Indra.

verses.text:
मद्रराजो महाराज विराटं वाहिनीपतिम् ।
आजघ्ने त्वरितं तीक्ष्णैः शतेन नतपर्वणाम् ॥

meaning.en: The king of Madra, great king, quickly struck Virata, lord of the army, with a hundred bent-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
प्रतिविव्याध तं राजा नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः ।
पुनश्चैव त्रिसप्तत्या भूयश्चैव शतेन ह ॥

meaning.en: The king (Virata) pierced him with nine sharp arrows, then with seventy-three, and again with a hundred.

verses.text:
तस्य मद्राधिपो हत्वा चतुरो रथवाजिनः ।
सूतं ध्वजं च समरे रथोपस्थादपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: The lord of the Madras killed his four chariot horses and brought his charioteer and banner down from the chariot's seat.

verses.text:
हताश्वात्तु रथात्तूर्णमवप्लुत्य महारथः ।
तस्थौ विस्फारयंश्चापं विमुञ्चंश्च शिताञ्शरान् ॥

meaning.en: The great warrior leapt quickly from his horseless chariot and stood stretching his bow and loosing sharp arrows.

verses.text:
शतानीकस्ततो दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं हतवाहनम् ।
रथेनाभ्यपतत्तूर्णं सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Then Shatanika, seeing his brother's mounts killed, quickly drove at him in his chariot while the whole world looked on.

verses.text:
शतानीकमथायान्तं मद्रराजो महामृधे ।
विशिखैर्बहुभिर्विद्ध्वा ततो निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: The king of Madra, in that great battle, pierced the advancing Shatanika with many arrows and sent him to Yama's house.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तु निहते वीरे विराटो रथसत्तमः ।
आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं तमेव ध्वजमालिनम् ॥

meaning.en: When that hero was killed, Virata, best of charioteers, quickly mounted that same chariot with its garland of banners.

verses.text:
ततो विस्फार्य नयने क्रोधाद्द्विगुणविक्रमः ।
मद्रराजरथं तूर्णं छादयामास पत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then, with eyes wide in anger and doubled in valor, he covered the chariot of the Madra king with arrows.

verses.text:
ततो मद्राधिपः क्रुद्धः शतेन नतपर्वणाम् ।
आजघानोरसि दृढं विराटं वाहिनीपतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the angry lord of the Madras struck Virata, lord of the army, hard in the chest with a hundred bent-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ।
कश्मलं चाविशत्तीव्रं विराटो भरतर्षभ ।
सारथिस्तमपोवाह समरे शरविक्षतम् ॥

meaning.en: Deeply wounded, great king, Virata sank onto the chariot's seat and was seized by sharp faintness, best of Bharatas; his charioteer carried him off, wounded by arrows.

verses.text:
ततः सा महती सेना प्राद्रवन्निशि भारत ।
वध्यमाना शरशतैः शल्येनाहवशोभिना ॥

meaning.en: Then that great army fled in the night, O Bharata, struck by hundreds of arrows from Shalya, who adorned the battle.

verses.text:
तां दृष्ट्वा विद्रुतां सेनां वासुदेवधनंजयौ ।
प्रायातां तत्र राजेन्द्र यत्र शल्यो व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the army in flight, Vasudeva and Dhananjaya drove to where Shalya stood, O king of kings.

verses.text:
तौ तु प्रत्युद्ययौ राजन्राक्षसेन्द्रो ह्यलम्बुसः ।
अष्टचक्रसमायुक्तमास्थाय प्रवरं रथम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the rakshasa lord Alambusa went out to meet them, O king, mounted on a splendid chariot with eight wheels.

verses.text:
तुरंगममुखैर्युक्तं पिशाचैर्घोरदर्शनैः ।
लोहितार्द्रपताकं तं रक्तमाल्यविभूषितम् ।
कार्ष्णायसमयं घोरमृक्षचर्मावृतं महत् ॥

meaning.en: It was drawn by dreadful pishachas with horses' faces, with banners wet with blood, adorned with red garlands, made of black iron, huge, and covered in bear-skin.

verses.text:
रौद्रेण चित्रपक्षेण विवृताक्षेण कूजता ।
ध्वजेनोच्छ्रिततुण्डेन गृध्रराजेन राजता ॥

meaning.en: Its banner showed a fierce vulture-king, with bright wings, open eyes, screaming, its beak raised, shining.

verses.text:
स बभौ राक्षसो राजन्भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः ।
रुरोधार्जुनमायान्तं प्रभञ्जनमिवाद्रिराट् ।
किरन्बाणगणान्राजञ्शतशोऽर्जुनमूर्धनि ॥

meaning.en: O king, the rakshasa looked like a heap of crushed collyrium. He blocked Arjuna as he came, as a king of mountains stops the wind, showering hundreds of arrows on Arjuna's head.

verses.text:
अतितीव्रमभूद्युद्धं नरराक्षसयोर्मृधे ।
द्रष्टॄणां प्रीतिजननं सर्वेषां भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: A most violent battle took place between the man and the rakshasa, giving delight to all who watched, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
तमर्जुनः शतेनैव पत्रिणामभ्यताडयत् ।
नवभिश्च शितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद ध्वजमुच्छ्रितम् ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna struck him with a hundred arrows and cut down his tall banner with nine sharp ones.

verses.text:
सारथिं च त्रिभिर्बाणैस्त्रिभिरेव त्रिवेणुकम् ।
धनुरेकेन चिच्छेद चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् ।
विरथस्योद्यतं खड्गं शरेणास्य द्विधाच्छिनत् ॥

meaning.en: He cut his charioteer with three arrows, his chariot's triple pole with three, his bow with one, and his four horses with four; and when the rakshasa, chariotless, raised his sword, he cut it in two with an arrow.

verses.text:
अथैनं निशितैर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिर्भरतर्षभ ।
पार्थोऽर्दयद्राक्षसेन्द्रं स विद्धः प्राद्रवद्भयात् ॥

meaning.en: Then, best of Bharatas, Partha tormented the rakshasa lord with four sharp arrows; wounded, he fled in fear.

verses.text:
तं विजित्यार्जुनस्तूर्णं द्रोणान्तिकमुपाययौ ।
किरञ्शरगणान्राजन्नरवारणवाजिषु ॥

meaning.en: Having beaten him, Arjuna quickly went toward Drona, scattering showers of arrows on men, elephants and horses, O king.

verses.text:
वध्यमाना महाराज पाण्डवेन यशस्विना ।
सैनिका न्यपतन्नुर्व्यां वातनुन्ना इव द्रुमाः ॥

meaning.en: Struck down by the glorious Pandava, the soldiers fell to the ground, O great king, like trees knocked down by the wind.

verses.text:
तेषु तूत्साद्यमानेषु फल्गुनेन महात्मना ।
संप्राद्रवद्बलं सर्वं पुत्राणां ते विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: While they were being cut down by the great-souled Phalguna, all your sons' army fled, O lord of the people.
